decisions.reason: The source's mechanics and prize-section wording changes are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source's layout restoration, text-sizing, and image-overlap constraints are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source changes hero and landing-page promotional copy, not the current FAQ content.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures flexible placement and size but omits the explicit requirement to crop the supplied cover image slightly.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
hmmmmm, I actually prefer the way you had it before.
The top of the landing page looks a bit messy now with the huge writing and large photo overlapping the 'view dashboard' button.

I liked the 'Project Rebuild' you had at the top before with the subtitles, and the whole layout, etc.

I wanted to change some of the wording (but you don't have to go character for character either, if it looks or feels messy or too repetitive or salesy), and I wanted to add bolding for emphasis to selling points, like '$500 random giveaway every 100 sales' or '$5 unlimited, instant commission' instead of having those selling points in brackets.

And I wanted to have the ebook cover on the landing page somewhere... it can be any size, whatever fits the aesthetics.

And it looks like the cover picture i sent you still needs to be cropped slightly.. can you do that or you want me to?

need to change 'win $500 every 100 sales!' to '$500 giveaway every 100 sales'.
and can drop 'constant little cracks at $500' and just leave it at '1 affiliate selected from each 100 sales block. More referrals = more chances to win!'
can also drop 'ongoing roulette spin:'

(my toddlers are driving me crazy right now, but ill be back in a little bit)

value_updates.placement: any aesthetically suitable location on the landing page
value_updates.image_cropping: crop the supplied cover image slightly

decisions.reason: The source changes how the existing $5 commission and $500 ticket are described and emphasized, not the underlying coded-referral reward.
The source does not change dashboard accounting or display of earned commissions and prize tickets.
The source revises promotional wording but does not alter automatic prize payout or winner notifications.
The source does not discuss or change reward handling for mints without a referral code.
The emphasized $5 commission is promotional copy and does not change the established $15 mint revenue allocation.
Displaying and cropping the book cover on the landing page does not change the PDF reader or offline-download experience.
The source does not change certificate actions, confirmation-email contents, or email-based ebook access.
The source changes wording about the recurring $500 giveaway but does not alter prize-pool funding sources or allocation.
